questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment of Public Service Commissions for the Union and for each State?
questions.explanation: Article 315 provides for the creation of Union and State Public Service Commissions.

questions.q: On which river is the Nagarjuna Sagar Dam constructed in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam was built across the Krishna River.

questions.q: Under which Schedule of the Indian Constitution are provisions regarding the administration of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes listed?
questions.explanation: The Fifth Schedule deals with administration of Scheduled Areas.

questions.q: Who founded the Asaf Jahi Dynasty in the Hyderabad State in the year 1724?
questions.explanation: Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan Siddiqi established the Asaf Jahi dynasty in 1724.

questions.q: Updated: Which organelle is universally known as the powerhouse of the cell?
Under the Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution, 'Police' and 'Public Order' are placed under which list?
questions.explanation: Police and Public Order are state subjects under State List (List II).

questions.q: If in a coded language 'POLICE' is coded as 'QPMJDF', how will 'FORCE' be coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by +1.

questions.q: What is the primary optical phenomenon responsible for the formation of a natural rainbow?
questions.explanation: A rainbow is formed due to dispersion, refraction, and internal reflection of sunlight in raindrops.

questions.q: According to Jean Piaget's theory of cognitive development, at which stage does object permanence develop?
questions.explanation: Object permanence develops during the Sensorimotor Stage.

questions.q: Who formulated the concept of the 'Zone of Proximal Development' (ZPD) in educational psychology?
questions.explanation: Lev Vygotsky formulated the concept of the Zone of Proximal Development.

questions.q: Which teaching method emphasizes learning through active student discovery and inductive problem solving?
questions.explanation: The Heuristic method, introduced by H.E. Armstrong, places learners in the role of discoverers.

questions.q: A train running at 54 km/h passes a telegraph post in 20 seconds. What is the length of the train?
Person A completes a task in 12 days and Person B completes the same task in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish?
Which layer in the OSI reference model is responsible for packet routing, logical IP addressing, and path determination?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer handles packet routing and logical IP addressing.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, __?
Which fundamental right in the Indian Constitution was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ambedkar termed Article 32 as the heart and soul of the Constitution.

questions.q: What is the chemical name of common table salt?
questions.explanation: Sodium Chloride (NaCl) is common table salt.

questions.q: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen accounts for approximately 78% of Earth's atmosphere.

questions.q: In which year was the Telangana State officially formed?
questions.explanation: Telangana was officially formed on June 2, 2014.

questions.q: Which district in Telangana is home to the UNESCO World Heritage Site Ramappa Temple?
questions.explanation: Ramappa Temple (Kakatiya Rudreshwara Temple) is situated in Mulugu district.

questions.q: What is the value of the acceleration due to gravity (g) at sea level on Earth?
questions.explanation: Standard acceleration due to gravity is approximately 9.8 m/s².

questions.q: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O Negative red blood cells have no A, B, or Rh antigens and can be given to all blood groups.

questions.q: What does CPU stand for in computer systems?
questions.explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit.

questions.q: Which protocol is used to transfer web pages securely across the Internet?
questions.explanation: HTTPS (HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure) provides encrypted web communications.

questions.q: If 15% of a number is 45, what is the number?

questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote Vande Mataram in his novel Anandamath.

questions.q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.explanation: Gujarat possesses the longest coastline in India (over 1,600 km).

questions.q: What is the primary function of white blood cells (leukocytes) in the human body?
questions.explanation: White blood cells fight against foreign pathogens and infections.

questions.q: Which amendment to the Indian Constitution lowered the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?
questions.explanation: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 reduced voting age to 18.

questions.q: In computing, what is the base of the hexadecimal numbering system?
questions.explanation: Hexadecimal is base 16, using digits 0-9 and letters A-F.
